title: Mik-Nana Food Scale, 22lb Digital Kitchen Scale Weight Grams and Ounces for Baking Cooking Coffee Package Postage, 6 Units with Tare Function, LCD Display, Easy Clean Stainless Steel (Silver)
description:
About this item
【Reliable Accuracy】- Accurately weigh items up to 10 kg/22 lb with 1 g increments. Great for cooking baking and weight loss.
【6 Units】- This food scale can easily converts units between g, kg, lb, oz, ml, milk ml.
【Easy Tare】- Remove the weight of any container to get more precise results.
【Portable Design】- The digital kitchen scale’s convenient size makes it easy to store in your kitchen.
【LCD Display】- Backlit LCD screen with large fonts for easy reading.
【Easy to Clean】- Digital gram scale is designed with food-grade 304 stainless-steel platform for easy cleaning and maintenance.
【Small Scale Dimensions】- 7 x 5.5 x 0.7 inches. The cute scale to turn off after 3 minutes inactivity.
reviews_5s:
This little scale has become my kitchen sidekick. It’s small, shiny, and surprisingly accurate—like, “wow I’ve been over-pouring olive oil my whole life” accurate.

Switching between grams, ounces, and other units is super easy, even if you’re half-awake and trying to weigh coffee before sunrise. The tare button is magic, especially when I pretend I know what I’m doing while meal prepping.

It’s lightweight (almost too lightweight—don’t sneeze near it), but the screen is clear, backlit, and doesn’t judge me for weighing cookies and salad in the same 5-minute window.

If you’re looking for a cute, functional scale that won’t take up half your counter, this one gets the job done and even shuts itself off when you’re done adulting.I've never used a scale before, so I do not have anything to compare but it was super easy to figure out. Works great to measure the grams needed for making sourdough bread.I love the different measurement settings. Very easy to use.I’m on a strict diet due to medical reasons and it turns out I suck at estimating food amounts. This little scale helps with that. It’s pretty flat so I can just slip it in a kitchen drawer when not in use. It has a zero function which is nice because I can put a plate on it, zero it, and measure my food.
The color makes it a little more fun. Easy to wipe down if I spill something on it. Battery seems to last, I have not had to replace them yet and it’s been a few months.Works as shouldSimple but effective. Slim profile makes it easy to store. It has a broad base unlike others which are significantly smaller. Bought it for weighing yarn skeins and it is accurate and simple to use with the different units available to meet my needs. Also good for weighing mail and light packages.Works well and seems pretty accurate. No complaints at allI love this. I use this to weigh my items before I ship them out.Given the modest price, I didn’t know what to expect from this little scale. It was just the size that I wanted and said it was able to handle packages up to 22 pounds, so I decided to try it. It works perfectly, has an easy-to-read screen, and has already weighed some large boxes with ease.I love the color and budget friendly 😊
